variants.name: baseline
variants.note: The live configuration, as the control arm: opus-5 on Claude Code.

variants.name: gpt-5.6-sol
variants.note: GPT-5.6 Sol through Codex. Named as the Codex CLI names it, not as OpenRouter does — the arm reaches the model through the Codex login, so no compatible-endpoint transform is involved. xhigh rather than max because max has no Codex spelling.

variants.name: direct-research
variants.note: The same model and runtime as baseline, with the data tools on the forecaster instead of behind research(). Against baseline it isolates the topology and nothing else. What it trades: delegating keeps raw tool output out of the forecaster's window and lets it fan out across several research agents at once, while holding the tools puts every observation in front of the reasoning that uses it. The forecaster's system prompt also carries ~45 tool descriptions rather than ~10, so a loss here may be prompt bloat rather than the topology.
